meta.title: About ecentic
meta.description: ecentic is an agent-commerce optimization platform that simulates how AI shopping agents compare your products with competitors, diagnoses why you win or lose, and rewrites the listings so those agents pick you, for Shopify and WooCommerce merchants.

hero.description: ecentic is an agent-commerce optimization platform that simulates how AI shopping agents compare your products with competitors, diagnoses why you win or lose, and rewrites the listings so those agents pick you, for Shopify and WooCommerce merchants.

does.title: What ecentic does
does.description: Four jobs, in the order a merchant actually needs them. Each one produces a result you can read, not a score with no next step.

items.title: Simulate shopping agents
items.body: ecentic runs ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity against your products and the competitors you choose. Each model scores both listings and picks a winner. You get a win rate, not a generic content grade.

items.title: Diagnose the loss
items.body: Every simulation keeps the agent's reasoning: which attributes it read, where the competitor was more complete, and which model favored which side. Battlecards turn that into a per-product comparison. The gap is visible instead of guessed.

items.title: Optimize the listing
items.body: The product rewrites titles, descriptions, and structured attributes from the losses it just measured. You approve the change in one click, or Scale, Dominate, and pay-as-you-go can publish it back to Shopify or WooCommerce. A later simulation measures whether the win rate moved.

items.title: Make the catalog agent-readable
items.body: A Universal Commerce Protocol profile gives agents a structured way to discover the store. ecentic generates that profile from the catalog you already connected. Agents that skip marketing HTML still have something precise to read.

different.title: What makes ecentic different
different.description: The tools merchants already shortlist solve a neighboring job. The difference is which decision ecentic is built to change.

items.title: It judges the agent decision, not the word count
items.body: Hypotenuse AI drafts descriptions and bullets across a catalog too large to write by hand. ecentic asks which listing an agent selects when two products are compared. If the copy already reads well and the agent still picks the competitor, a generator will not show you why.

items.title: It sees the competitor
items.body: Shopify Magic drafts inside the admin you already use, and it only ever sees your store. ecentic places your listing next to a competitor's and asks the same models a shopper would. The diagnosis is the gap between the two, not a rewrite of your page in isolation.

items.title: The choice happens before your theme
items.body: Nosto changes what a returning visitor sees on your site: recommendations, segments, and merchandising rules. Agent shopping often ends before anyone lands on that theme. ecentic works on the listing the agent reads while it is still choosing.

items.title: A lean team can start the same day
items.body: Bloomreach runs search, merchandising, and campaign data as one stack, and that implementation outruns the problem a lean team has today. ecentic starts with a free scan of 10 products. There is no implementation project before the first result.

items.title: The terms are month to month
items.body: Every paid plan is month-to-month, with no minimums and no setup fee. Pay-as-you-go stays free until an AI-attributed order, then takes 3% of that order, capped at $500 a month. Flat plans are Compete at $14.90, Scale at $44.90, and Dominate at $149, with no performance fee.

who.title: Who uses ecentic
who.description: The product is for the merchant whose catalog is already being compared by a shopping agent, or will be.

stories.title: How ecentic started
stories.body: Shopping agents read structured product data. They do not scroll a theme or trust a brand paragraph. ECENTIC SH.P.K. was founded in Tirana on 4 April 2026 to close that gap for Shopify and WooCommerce merchants.

stories.title: Who is on the team
stories.body: Three founders, engineering in Tirana, and zennit as the studio behind the product. Self-serve customers work in the product itself. Enterprise accounts get a named customer success manager, quarterly reviews, and a direct engineering escalation path.

works.title: How ecentic works
works.description: What happens after you decide to try it: who answers, how you start, and how fast the first result shows up.

items.title: Communication
items.body: Email support@ecentic.ai for account, billing, and integration questions, and include your store URL. A 15-minute live walkthrough is bookable from the support page. We do not publish a response-time number; Enterprise accounts have a named customer success manager and a direct engineering escalation path.

items.title: Who you work with
items.body: On the free scan, pay-as-you-go, Compete, Scale, and Dominate, you work in the product: the scan, the battlecards, and the optimization queue. Enterprise adds a named customer success manager. There is no agency team between you and the listing.

items.title: Onboarding
items.body: Connect Shopify or WooCommerce, choose the products, add competitor listings, and run the scan. The free scan covers your top 10 products across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity. No credit card is required to start.

items.title: Turnaround
items.body: A free scan returns in about two minutes. Listing rewrites then wait in a queue you approve in one click, or they publish automatically on Scale, Dominate, and pay-as-you-go. Compete resimulates daily. Scale and Dominate run continuously.

faqSection.title: Frequently asked questions
faqSection.description: Short answers, in the same words the rest of this page uses.

items.question: What is ecentic?
items.answer: ecentic is an agent-commerce optimization platform for Shopify and WooCommerce merchants. It simulates how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity compare your products with competitors, shows why you win or lose, and rewrites the listing from that evidence.

items.question: Who founded ecentic?
items.answer: Xhurian Shaba, Iseld Muça, and Alvi Palloshi founded ECENTIC SH.P.K. in Tirana on 4 April 2026. Xhurian is chief executive and the company's administrator. The product is built with zennit, the studio he co-founded.

items.question: Where is ecentic based?
items.answer: The development team works from Tirana. ECENTIC SH.P.K. is the Albanian subsidiary, at Pallatet Merkaj, Hyrja 1, Dera 12, Rruga Muhamed Deliu, Qesarakë. Support and calls are in English.

items.question: How much does ecentic cost, and can I cancel?
items.answer: The scan is free. Pay-as-you-go is 3% of AI-attributed orders, capped at $500 a month, with no card until a fee is due. Compete is $14.90, Scale is $44.90, and Dominate is $149 a month, with no performance fee. Plans are month-to-month and you can cancel anytime.

items.question: How is ecentic different from Shopify Magic or a copy tool?
items.answer: Shopify Magic drafts inside your admin and only sees your store. Hypotenuse AI drafts catalog copy at scale. ecentic compares your listing with a competitor's, asks the shopping agents which one they pick, and rewrites from that result.

items.question: How does a new merchant start?
items.answer: Connect the store, pick products, add competitors, and run the scan. The free scan of 10 products takes about two minutes, and you do not need a card. Paid plans continue the same loop on a schedule.
